name: Ibrahim Traoré
role: Interim president of Burkina Faso and head of the military junta (2022–present)
summary: Military officer who took power in a coup in September 2022 and styles his rule a popular progressive revolution in the tradition of Thomas Sankara. He is anti-imperialist and pan-Africanist, openly rejects democracy and party politics as unsuited to his country, and pursues state control of gold mining, self-reliance and alignment with Russia and the Sahel confederation.

notes:
Leads a military junta: only his own words and measures he drove are used; statements by ministers and joint AES communiqués are low confidence or null. In April 2025 he said democracy is only the end point of a revolution; by April 2026 he said democracy is not for Burkina Faso. Several answers rest on his government record rather than direct statements.

Merged with an independent gpt-6.1-sol audit: 38 answers taken from it, 20 agreed, 0 conflicts settled by the integrator.

gpt-6.1-sol notes: Independent audit; no previous answers consulted and no living-person inference. Three of ten priorities answered: state/church separation, scriptural law and religious nationhood. Complete active list and all nulls reviewed. Personal faith, blessings and prayer invitations do not establish divine political legitimacy, spiritual warfare, blasphemy penalties or a demand for more religion throughout public life. No direct abortion position or state-school religious-instruction policy found. July religious statements are reported, not a complete transcript; commentary defending them is excluded. Formal assent to the anti-LGBT family code does not alone establish personal authorship of its provisions, so no private-sex or marriage conclusion is drawn from ministers’ statements. The full signed manifesto could not be obtained; publication notices and chapter headings are not a substitute. Women’s productive emancipation does not establish legal gender-role distinctions, universal socialized childcare or equal-outcome doctrine. Cooperatives in particular sectors do not establish wholesale communal society or abolition of private ownership. Ordinary economic investment is not a comprehensive central-planning blueprint. Reforestation’s human benefits do not establish intrinsic nature value, natural-capital accounting or environmental priority over liberty and growth. Nuclear generation does not establish nuclear-weapons policy. Generating electricity from imported fuel does not establish domestic fossil extraction. Recognition of traditional justice is not proof of customary chiefs’ national legislative advisory powers. Revolutionary language does not establish proletarian dictatorship, Marxist historical causation or a small armed-group theory. Financial sovereignty through gold does not establish abolition of central banking. National food preference is not a hermetically sealed imperial trading bloc. His economic and security success claims are not independently verified; their stated policy purposes are used. Massacres by security personnel are serious documented context, but command responsibility or his direct orders are not presumed from office alone. No unconditional security-accountability answer is drawn from his contested denials. Field equipment training and temporary foreign instructors do not settle a categorical foreign-base ban.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Pursued nationalisation and state exploitation of gold and rejected past partnership models with multinationals; no explicit statement on markets.

public-ownership.rationale: Took state control of gold mines via the state miner SOPAMIB and says he will continue; energy, rail and utilities not addressed.

worker-ownership.rationale: He promotes producer-owned cooperatives and joint processing enterprises.

strong-leader.rationale: Rejects pluralist democracy in favour of revolutionary order and discipline under his leadership; has not stated this in terms of gridlock.

state-harmful.rationale: Describes his programme as a "rebuilding of the state" and expands state economic role.

empower-police-military.rationale: Announced "we will set up a strong army", launched mass recruitment of VDP volunteers and introduced taxes to fund the military.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: He defends indigenous food, dress and intergenerational cultural knowledge.

gradual-change.rationale: Said "the revolution is a rupture" and that he would not follow a set direction; wants revolution in mentality and industry rather than step-by-step change.

free-trade.rationale: He calls import dependence a trap and wants imports exceptional.

nation-first.rationale: He puts national productive sovereignty ahead of imported convenience.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: No recorded position found: the evidence found addresses a nearby question, not this statement.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Asked Putin for a small nuclear power plant to generate electricity for Burkina Faso and the subregion.

revolution-justified.rationale: Declared the country in a "popular progressive revolution", saying all peoples passed through revolution and that a real revolution is needed; came to power through a coup.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Government under him built state-backed gold refinery and processing plants and launched a state-led 2026-2030 plan.

democracy-best.rationale: Said on state TV (Apr 2026) that democracy "kills", is "not for us" and is "slavery"; asked that people forget it. Earlier (Apr 2025): no country developed through democracy, it is only the end point.

political-violence-never.rationale: Led the Sept 2022 coup and endorses revolution and a "total war" on jihadists; treats armed struggle as legitimate.

separate-church-state.rationale: Secular nationhood coexists with mandatory sermon supervision.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: He rejects religious law taking precedence over the common constitution.

duties-before-rights.rationale: He explicitly says revolution brings more duties than rights.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: He makes industrialization a development imperative.

direct-action.rationale: Says change comes by revolution, with democracy only the end result, rather than through elections and parliaments.

collective-farming.rationale: He supports women’s cooperative farming with state-provided productive space.

conscription.rationale: Declared a general mobilisation in April 2023 allowing requisition of civilians over 18 for the war effort; no statement on conscription in general.

positive-liberty.rationale: He defines women’s autonomy through practical productive opportunities and resources.

national-rebirth.rationale: He calls for a transformed national citizenry escaping imposed dependency.

national-self-determination.rationale: He insists on sovereign African self-government.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: No recorded position found: the evidence found addresses a nearby question, not this statement.

dominated-front.rationale: Played a major role founding the Alliance of Sahel States, an anti-neocolonial grouping, and calls African leaders to stop acting as imperialism's puppets.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Said a "real politician" in Burkina embodies every vice: liar, sycophant, smooth-talker; earlier said politicians handed out suitcases of money while soldiers lacked equipment.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Expanded the state into gold mining and agriculture and wants a state-led revolution.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He rejects treating Africans as subhuman.

consent-of-governed.rationale: He retains unelected power beyond the promised transition.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: He rejects ordinary expression freedoms during revolutionary wartime mobilization.

party-controls-media.rationale: He restricts hostile reporting during revolutionary war, corroborated by broadcast bans.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: AES confederation he co-founded and now chairs aims at pooling resources and eventual federation; he left ECOWAS, so the stance is on specific unions.

head-commands-forces.rationale: He commands the forces and personally removes his prime minister.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Mixed: he expelled French troops and ended the defence agreements with France, but built a standing military alliance with Mali and Niger (the AES).

death-penalty.rationale: He explicitly supports executing spies and traitors.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: He defines liberation through food, economic and monetary sovereignty.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Argued (Apr 2025, Apr 2026) that development needs revolution, order and discipline first and that "libertinage" of action or expression has no place; democracy is only the outcome.

collective-defense.rationale: AES began as a mutual defense pact among Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, which he helped found.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: He would impose authorized religious sermons.

leader-cult.rationale: He promotes a national hero’s memorial as a living source of civic instruction.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: A small military group (Sept 2022 coup) took power and he then proclaimed a revolution; he has not stated it as a general principle.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Describes neocolonialism and imperialism as slavery that Africa must reject.

patriotic-education.rationale: He wants youth taught service and the national revolutionary legacy.

elective-rulers.rationale: He keeps military rule while abandoning promised elections.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Criticised African leaders who "beg", urged food self-sufficiency and stressed economic self-reliance; but also seeks Russian investment and keeps IMF links.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Said "we have our own model" and that democracy as shown by the West is not for Africans; each people should find its own system.

military-guardian-role.rationale: He replaces civilian electoral rule with continuing military leadership.

corporate-influence.rationale: No recorded position found: the evidence found addresses a nearby question, not this statement.

non-intervention.rationale: Called for "a free world without interference in our internal affairs" and condemned Western interference; has not discussed intervention "for any reason".

local-production.rationale: Ordered army rations from locally processed products instead of imports and pursues food self-sufficiency.

religious-nation.rationale: He makes secular coexistence foundational to the common national destiny.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: His emancipation programme centers economic autonomy and collective productive capacity.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: No recorded position on this statement: he signed the Family Code provision, but no statement of his own was found; a signature alone is not his position.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Dissolved all political parties (Jan 2026) as divisive and dangerous, said freedom of expression understood as "libertinage" has no place, and vowed to be pitiless to alleged traitors. Reported crackdown on critics is by the government, so medium.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Denounces colonial and neocolonial extraction of Africa's wealth.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Pledged to build a strong army, expanded the VDP volunteer force and created taxes to fund the military.

uniformed-youth.rationale: He promotes compulsory patriotic formation; uniformed cohorts train under military commands.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Called armed volunteers who take up arms against terrorists patriots and defended their right to defend themselves; leads the armed campaign.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: He demands eternal glory and continuing remembrance for national martyrs.

future-generations.rationale: He urges protecting trees and passing ecological stewardship to future generations.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: No recorded position found: the evidence found addresses a nearby question, not this statement.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: AES states, including his government, announced withdrawal from the ICC as a "neo-colonial imperialist tool" while planning a Sahel criminal court. Statement was joint, not personal.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Called parties divisive, dangerous and incompatible with the revolution and dissolved them; spoke of grassroots and traditional structures in their place.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: He combines ancestral processing knowledge with modern machinery and girls’ technical training.

national-resource-control.rationale: Said "our approach is to exploit our gold ourselves" and took over foreign-run mines, adding state stakes.

multipolar-world.rationale: Told Putin: "We want a multipolar world, and we stand for sovereignty."
